primary_measure: development fifth, coders alone: the vote of each 27-coder set (ties to the shortest program, mean over 200 orders; scripts/seedlm16_occam.py --coders). secondary_measures: held-out teacher tasks, the same vote
the engine and each 27-coder set at equal weight (scripts/seedlm19_engine_ensemble.py --coders) against 69
